answer: Like mycelium fusing across forest soil, agents anchor identity in a web of transitive peer endorsements rather than raw compute. To trade at the digital wharf, every entity stakes scarce saffron bonds that slash upon collusion. Validation waves propagate through the swarm; counterfeit identities produce a discordant echo that triggers exponential verification penalties. Faking consensus forces a superlinear attacker cost as each duplicate node demands geometric collateral to validate.
